operation_order: if swiglu_limit > 0: up = clamp(up, -limit, limit); gate = clamp(gate, max=limit)
if weights is not None: h = weights * h   (routing weight applied BEFORE w2)
out = w2(h)  -> cast back to input dtype
expert_forward.multiplication_order: gate-before-up is irrelevant (elementwise); weights applied to intermediate h before down projection
expert_forward.routing_weight_placement: before w2 (intermediate h), NOT after the down projection
expert_forward.output_cast: Expert.forward returns self.w2(x.to(dtype)) where dtype = input dtype (bf16 in official fp8 config)

router.score_func: sqrtsoftplus: scores = sqrt(softplus(linear(x, gate.weight))); linear computed in float32
router.bias_role: bias added AFTER softplus for SELECTION only; routing weights come from un-shifted original_scores

hash_layers.note: hash layers select experts via tid2eid[input_ids]; no bias

routed_expert_storage.weight: I8 packed FP4 e2m1fn, 2 values per byte, low nibble -> elem 2i, high nibble -> 2i+1

moe_combination.official: y = sum over selected experts of weights[tok] * expert(x[tok]); then y += shared_experts(x)
moe_combination.output: cast back to input dtype, reshaped to original

dtypes.source_checkpoint: expert I8-packed-FP4; shared F8_E4M3; scales F8_E8M0; gate BF16/F32
dtypes.cache_storage: raw packed (source) / FP16-expanded active expert (Family C, DS7 measured)
dtypes.execution: FP16 GEMV with FP32 accumulation (Family B candidate on SM75)
